facts.activity_file: testing earth leakage and protection settings

control_failures.control_label: authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.title: improvement notice - material unwanted event control at TX-7001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on TX-7001 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. TX-7001 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 23 March 2024 a regulatory notice was issued concerning TX-7001 at Cape Verity Export Terminal following a statutory inspection.
